title: Open the highlighted result in the same tab by pressing Enter
Open the highlighted result in a new browser tab with Cmd+Enter (Ctrl+Enter)
The 'All' tab shows results from every entity group together
The 'Customers' tab shows only Customer results
The 'Assets' tab shows only Asset (vehicle) results
The 'Parts' tab shows only Part (inventory) results
The 'Vendors' tab shows only Vendor results
The 'Part Sales' tab shows only Part Sales results
Selecting a scope tab shows only that entity's results with its count
No Contacts tab or group appears; a contact match returns its company
The 'Vendor Invoices' tab shows only Vendor Invoice results
Each result group shows a heading with the total match count
A group shows up to five results (raised from three)
A 'Show all' link appears when a group has more than five matches
Clicking 'Show all N' switches the modal to that entity's scope tab
A screen reader announces the results count when it changes
A contact match returns its company row (Contacts are not a separate group)
An Asset result shows year/make/model and the owning customer
A Part result shows description, part number and a quantity chip colored by stock level
A Vendor result shows the vendor name and address
A Part Sale result shows the P-number, customer, status badge, total price and date
A phonetically-similar name still finds the record - 'Filbridge' finds 'Fibridge'
A telephone number matches on digits only, ignoring formatting
An accented name matches with or without the accent
Sound-alike matching applies to names only, not to part numbers or descriptions
A near spelling of a customer contact name is shown and marked as close
A near spelling of a Vendor contact name is shown and marked as close
An exact identifier match is pinned as a single row at the very top
Within a group, more relevant results appear first
In-stock parts rank above out-of-stock parts (out-of-stock not hidden)
On a Customer page, that customer's assets and work orders are boosted
On a Work Order page, parts already on that work order are pushed down
A contact-field match scores as a secondary-field match on its company
A prefix name match ranks above a whole-word match, which ranks above a fuzzy match
Customers with an open work order and recently viewed rank higher
Assets with an open work order (and recently viewed) rank higher
Vendors with open purchase orders (and recently used) rank higher
Recent part sales, yours, and paid ones rank higher
Recently sold and recently viewed parts rank higher
A customer with more open work orders ranks above one with fewer
A result matched on its name ranks above one matched only on a secondary field
Prefix name match ranks above a whole-word match with all other signals held equal
An exact identifier match is pinned at the very top even when a strong name match exists
A matching record ranked below the top 20 is not shown until the query is narrowed
Parts tab: a part whose name begins with the query ranks above one that only contains it
Vendors tab: a vendor whose name begins with the query ranks above one that only contains it
Assets tab: a vehicle whose name begins with the query ranks above one that only contains it
Recent activity is grouped under Today, Yesterday, Past week and Past 30 days
Recent activity mixes different entity types using the same row template
Clicking a recent item opens that record
Recent-entities API records views and serves a deduped, permission-filtered list
Clear all empties the history and returns to the first-time state
Reopening the palette restores the last query, scope tab and result list
The persisted query can be cleared with the clear (x) button
No-results in a scoped tab reads 'No results for [query] in [Tab]'
Searching the in-page Work Orders list filters the list, with the term in the search box
Clearing the in-page Work Orders search restores the full list
A search failure shows the 'Search unavailable, retry' banner
A user WITH Parts access sees Parts results in the palette
A technician WITHOUT Parts access does NOT see Parts results
A user WITHOUT Work Orders access does NOT see Work Order results
Results are limited to the signed-in user's own tenant
An entity type with no accessible records shows no group (and its scope tab shows the empty state)
Permission bundles hide whole groups, their counts and tabs; prices masked without financial access
A user WITH Work Orders access sees Work Order results in the palette
A user WITH Customers access sees Customer and Asset results in the palette
A user WITH Part Sales access sees Part Sale results in the palette
A user WITH Vendor & Order Management access sees Vendor, Purchase Order and Vendor Invoice results
A user WITH See Financial Data sees prices in search result rows
The recent-searches list only shows records the person can currently access
Typing the exact number of a record you cannot access does not surface it (no pinned top hit)
A contact-field match is hidden when you cannot access its parent company
A role missing several access areas hides all of them together and keeps the rest
A typo search does not leak a record you cannot access
Flipping only Parts access shows then hides the same part in search
Flipping only Work Orders access shows then hides the same work order
Flipping only Customers access shows then hides the same customer and its vehicle
Flipping only Part Sales access shows then hides the same part sale
Flipping only Vendor & Order Management access hides the same vendor, PO and invoice
Removing See Financial Data hides the total on a Vendor invoice row but keeps the row
Records a person cannot see are not counted in any heading, tab or total
Old global-search path is removed on direct rollout (no feature flag)
Global search works on mobile/tablet viewports per the mobile design
On mobile the search is a full-screen surface with a Cancel action
On mobile the scope chip row appears only with a query and lists matched types
Mobile first-time, recent and no-results states match web (no quick-create buttons)
Purchase Orders searchable; real number format; Receive quick action
Vendor Invoices are searchable with a tri-state payment badge and no quick action
Vendor results appear only with Vendor & Order Management access
An unrecognised result type is hidden unless explicitly permitted
Recent items the user can no longer access are hidden
Results never include another organization's records
Selecting the record you are already on does not re-navigate
Global search is available with no feature-flag toggle
A newly created customer is findable within 30 seconds
A new work order or part sale is findable within 30 seconds
More recent work orders rank above older ones of equal relevance
Search can be reached on a phone and a tablet as well as a desktop
